read.thesis: BHP's nine-month operational review shows copper output down 3% YTD to 1,461 kt, but FY26 copper guidance moved to the upper half, with Escondida unit costs cut and Antamina raised; supply discipline shows in Spence cuts and project deferral signals.

triggers.label: Copper FY26 guidance to upper half
triggers.quote: FY26 Group copper production is now expected to be in the upper half of the guidance range

triggers.label: Escondida unit cost cut to US$1.00–1.20/lb
triggers.quote: Unit cost guidance for FY26 has been lowered to between US$1.00 and US$1.20/lb (from US$1.20 to US$1.50/lb previously)

triggers.label: Spence FY26 guidance lowered 230–250 → 210–220 kt
triggers.quote: Production guidance for FY26 has been lowered to between 210 and 220 kt (from between 230 and 250 kt previously).

triggers.label: Escondida new concentrator FID pushed to CY27-28
triggers.quote: Subject to environmental permit approval, the project will progress towards an expected final investment decision (FID) in CY27-28

guidance.quote: FY26 Group copper production is now expected to be in the upper half of the guidance range
Unit cost guidance for FY26 has been lowered to between US$1.00 and US$1.20/lb (from US$1.20 to US$1.50/lb previously)
Production guidance for FY26 has been lowered to between 210 and 220 kt (from between 230 and 250 kt previously).
We now expect Antamina’s copper production for FY26 to be between 150 and 160 kt (from 140 to 150 kt previously).
Production guidance for FY26 remains unchanged at between 251 and 262 Mt

prior_guidance_check.quote: Copper production guidance for FY26 remains unchanged at between 1,900 and 2,000 kt and is now expected to be in the upper half of the range.
Iron ore production guidance for FY26 remains unchanged at between 258 and 269 Mt.

red_flags.label: Spence copper down 19% YTD, guidance cut
red_flags.quote: Production decreased due to challenges with managing the ore complexity, variation and declining grades at both the concentrator and the cathode plant.

red_flags.label: Energy cost pressure from Middle East conflict
red_flags.quote: industry wide pressure on the cost of energy and consumables as a result of the conflict in the Middle East
